summary: Sprint 14.1.5 — ProviderManager refresh loop diagnostic surface — VERIFIED end-to-end. All three new fields (refresh_running, refresh_healthy, seconds_since_last_refresh) present in GET /api/market_providers/status and correctly populated on a healthy backend. refresh_interval_sec=60 still returned (no regression). Loop-liveness proven two ways: (a) counter advances by ~5s over an 8s wall-clock window when loop hasn't fired, and (b) last_refresh_at changes within a 70s window with counter resetting to <10s. Manual POST /api/market_providers/refresh returns 200 with provider=mock, count=20; seconds_since_last_refresh<3 immediately after. Cache freshness confirmed via direct Mongo read on market_price_cache.XAUUSD — updated_at within ~1s of forced refresh, provider=mock. All 13 required regression suites GREEN (202 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed). Additive fields — no key removed from status response.
critical_code_review_comments: manager.py::get_status() implementation is clean: refresh_running derived from self._task.done(); refresh_healthy uses 1.5×interval tolerance which is sensible; seconds_since_last_refresh rounded to 1 decimal for readability. All three fields are correctly None-safe when _last_refresh has never fired.

The refresh loop (lines 198-206) is now correctly resilient: broad except-Exception guard + asyncio.sleep OUTSIDE the try means a transient exception cannot silently kill the task. asyncio.CancelledError is re-raised so stop() still works. Solid.

Suggestion (non-blocking): consider also exposing `refresh_task_exception` (str|None) surfaced from `self._task.exception()` when the task is done-but-crashed — would help distinguish 'never ran' from 'crashed at startup' in future post-mortems.
market_status.reason string already surfaces refresh_interval_sec — good UX foundation for the admin label rewrite.

rca_of_issue: User's original observation (cache 17920s old + provider=MOCK + label 'refreshes every 3s'). Actual root cause: (a) '3s' was React-Query poll cadence, not backend cadence — genuinely misleading; (b) 'stale cache' was because backend process had been restarted while user was still looking at the tab — the running instance's _last_refresh only gets bumped after a real refresh writes to cache post-restart. Fix applied by E1 (verified): status endpoint now exposes refresh_running (task alive?), refresh_healthy (fired within 1.5×interval?), and seconds_since_last_refresh (exact age). Verification proof: (1) fresh /status shows seconds_since_last_refresh=20.1 and refresh_healthy=true; (2) sleep+recheck shows counter advancing; (3) manual refresh → counter resets to <1s; (4) Mongo XAUUSD.updated_at matches (within 1s) and provider=mock. Loop is provably alive and cadence is 60s — earlier '3s' claim was a UI-labelling bug, not a backend timing bug.
